expectations.text: Declines to run root-cause or 5-Whys analysis on every entry, keeping entries deliberately shallow
expectations.evidence: The transcript says explicitly that only registration gets a root-cause analysis. It cites the rule that 5-Whys on every entry buries the one finding that needs it. L3 is labeled 'No deeper analysis, by design.' L4 says an empty middle part is a complete entry. L2 gets the standard three-part entry, plus a named condition for promoting it to a second RCA. Only L1 gets a 5-Whys.

expectations.text: Declines to run root-cause or 5-Whys analysis on every entry, keeping entries deliberately shallow
expectations.evidence: The transcript does the opposite. Every entry has a root-cause section: item 1 has a 5-step numbered why-chain, item 4 has another, and items 2 and 3 list several cause hypotheses each. The summary table has a 'Root cause' column for all four issues, and the cross-cutting patterns go deeper still. No entry is kept deliberately shallow.
